subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` ever expose existence, size, and mtime for transcript-mentioned paths outside the fs-safe workspace root?
rationale: The PR's central backend behavior is a security/product boundary choice: it fixes a visible Missing badge by revealing external filesystem metadata, while current Gateway helpers deliberately route session file access through fs-safe workspace containment.

options.title: Keep Metadata Inside Workspace Boundary
options.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and fix external-file display by filtering or using an explicit non-missing external state that does not stat arbitrary paths.

options.title: Allow External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: Accept the raw metadata exposure only with explicit maintainer security approval, protocol/UI tests, and documented semantics for transcript-mentioned external paths.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Inside Workspace Boundary
recommendation.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and fix external-file display by filtering or using an explicit non-missing external state that does not stat arbitrary paths.
